reuse.why: Reuses ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and the server-config/SYNC_PROVIDERS registries, but writes the account create-or-upgrade and initial-sync flow again instead of extracting it from the existing provider link functions.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a copy of the SimpleFin/Akahu link body and downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of the other providers' download functions, adding two more copies of logic already repeated per provider.

placement.why: Each piece lands where the tree puts it: link handler and registration in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, types in types/models.

scope.why: Only the server-side pieces needed for the new provider.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern so it is easy to read, but each further provider-wide change now has one more copy to update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: There is no shared link-finishing helper in this tree to go around; the existing guard and sync helpers are used.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (accounts/app.ts) repeats the SimpleFin link body compressed into one-line ifs, and downloadFintegraTransactions (accounts/sync.ts) mixes SimpleFin's timeout catch with Akahu's response mapping, reshaping copies rather than sharing them.
